about.text1: CV. Teak & Deko Indonesia buys and produces natural furniture and decoration — tables, chairs, wall decoration, garden and interior pieces — for export to Europe, the USA, the Middle East and for the local Indonesian market.

story.label: Our story
story.title: Natural furniture for export since 2016
story.p1: CV. Teak & Deko Indonesia is a company that buys and produces natural furniture and decoration: tables, chairs, wall decoration, garden decoration and interior decoration. We export to Europe, the USA and the Middle East, and also serve the local Indonesian market.
story.p2: Before the company was founded, our team spent six years managing buyers' containers shipped from Indonesia to their own countries. That experience — knowing what international buyers need, how to load a container and how to keep quality consistent — is the foundation of everything we do today.
story.p3: Most of our material is rest wood and recycled wood. Most of it is teak, and we use trembesi wood as well. Instead of using this wood the way it is, or letting it end as firewood, we make useless wood become precious wood by creating many products from it.
story.gardenAlt: Garden display of teak root furniture under tropical trees with a thatched gazebo

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: Reduce global warming and reduce forest destruction.

materials.label: Materials
materials.title: The wood we work with
materials.intro: We do not need to fell healthy trees. Our raw material is what is left behind.

rest.title: Rest wood
rest.text: Roots, stumps and branches left in the ground or the field after harvest. Their twisted, organic forms become sculptural tables, stools and decoration.

recycled.title: Recycled wood
recycled.text: Old beams, planks and offcuts given a new purpose as tabletops, consoles, trays and candle holders — with the patina of their first life.

teak.title: Teak
teak.text: Most of our pieces are teak (Tectona grandis): dense, naturally oily and resistant to weather and insects, ideal for indoor and outdoor use.

trembesi.title: Trembesi
trembesi.text: Trembesi (rain tree, Samanea saman) has wide, dramatic slabs with contrasting light and dark grain, used for statement tables and consoles.

process.label: Production
process.title: Inside our workshop
process.text: From sorting the raw stock to the final sanding, every step happens at our workshop in Pajangan, Bantul. Buyers are welcome to visit, see the stock and choose pieces in person.

hero.label: FAQ
hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Everything buyers usually ask before their first order. Can't find your answer? Send us a message.

material.q: What materials are your products made from?
material.a: Most of our products are made from rest wood (roots, stumps and branches) and recycled wood (old beams and offcuts). Most of it is teak, and we also use trembesi wood. We do not need to cut down healthy trees for our products.

unique.q: Will I receive exactly the piece in the photo?
unique.a: Every piece is made from natural wood, so shape, size and grain are unique. Our photos show the style; before you confirm, we can send photos of the actual pieces available for your order.

outdoor.q: Can teak furniture be used outdoors?
outdoor.a: Teak is naturally oily and resistant to weather and insects, which makes it one of the best woods for gardens and terraces. Untreated teak slowly turns silver-grey outdoors; regular care keeps its warm colour.

custom.a: Send us a sketch, a reference photo and your target size. Because we work with natural roots and reclaimed wood, we check what is possible with the material in stock and confirm with you before production.

process.q: How do I place an order?
process.a: Choose your pieces from the website or our e-catalog, send us an inquiry by WhatsApp or the contact form, and we confirm the selection, price, packing and payment. After production and quality check we load and ship your container.

moq.q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
moq.a: Our minimum order quantity is [MOQ]. Contact us if you would like to start with a smaller trial order.

leadTime.a: Production time is [PRODUCTION TIME], depending on the quantity, the pieces selected and the material in stock. We confirm the exact schedule with your order.

shipping.a: Yes. We export to Europe, the USA and the Middle East, and also supply buyers within Indonesia. We have managed export containers since 2010. Our port of loading is [PORT].

payment.a: Our payment terms are [PAYMENT TERMS]. All terms are confirmed in writing before production starts.

certificates.q: Which certificates and export documents can you provide?
certificates.a: We can provide [CERTIFICATES]. Let us know the requirements of your country when you send your inquiry.

visit.a: Yes, you are welcome. Our workshop and garden display are at Dsn. Gupak Warak Rt. 04, Sendangsari, Pajangan, Bantul, Yogyakarta. Please contact us beforehand so we can welcome you.

language.q: Which languages do you communicate in?
language.a: We communicate with buyers in English and Indonesian, by WhatsApp, email or in person at the workshop.
